settings.whatLeavesDeviceSubtitle: Nothing. Here is what exists anyway.
settings.whatLeavesDeviceBody:
Nothing. Your expenses, refunds, money in, categories, debts, budgets, accounts and recurring entries never leave this phone. Reminders are notifications this phone schedules for itself. zero has no servers, no sign-in and no analytics.

What exists anyway, outside our reach:
settings.exportCsvSubtitle: Expenses, refunds and money in, for spreadsheets

settings.whatLeavesDeviceExports: Backups you export live wherever you save or send them. Automatic backups (Pro) are encrypted and stay in the folder you choose; if that folder is in iCloud Drive, iOS syncs it, not zero.
settings.whatLeavesDeviceBackup: A device-level backup you switch on may include this app's data.
settings.whatLeavesDeviceAccess: Anyone who can unlock your phone can open zero and read it.
